verdict.rationale: First-party docs offer self-managed deployment options, including a one-line Docker quickstart (start-local) that runs Elasticsearch and Kibana locally. Community users confirm running their own clusters, for example via Elastic Cloud on Kubernetes and self-hosted Kibana. Missing for 10: in-depth evidence of production-grade self-managed install docs (the quickstart is scoped to development/testing), and clarity on which features are free when self-hosted, since community reports say some features such as security were historically paid-only.
